ai.title: Block unverifiable free-mode countries
ai.summary: Free mode now requires a resolved allowlisted country; unknown, VPN, Tor, proxy, or anonymized traffic returns `country_blocked` with `countryCode: 'UNKNOWN'`. The chat-completions gate and session handler replace the old fail-open `getCountryCode` logic with `getFreeModeCountryAccess`, removing the `geoip-lite` dependency from the completions path. CLI `waiting-room-screen` renders a distinct message for unverified locations, and `common/src/types/freebuff-session.ts` updates the `country_blocked` contract to document the `UNKNOWN` sentinel.

eli5.text: When you start a free session, the tool now checks whether it can tell where you're connecting from. If it can't identify a trusted country, for example, because your traffic looks like it's coming through a VPN, Tor, a proxy, or an unknown network, the system blocks the session and shows you a message instead of letting you join the queue. That blocked response carries a placeholder country code of UNKNOWN so the interface can display a distinct screen rather than a misleading country name. The previous behavior allowed connections through when location couldn't be determined; that fail-open path has been removed for both the chat gateway and the session handler, replacing the older country lookup with a new check that only permits connections from verified allowlisted countries.

ai.title: Free mode country gating now requires IPINFO TOKEN
ai.summary: Free mode country gating now resolves VPN/proxy/Tor/relay/hosting traffic through the IPinfo API using the new required IPINFO_TOKEN env var, replacing the previous country-only check. getFreeModeCountryAccess in web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts became async, adds a 5000-entry 30-minute TTL in-memory cache keyed by client IP, and exports FreeModeIpPrivacySignal, FreeModeIpPrivacy, LookupIpPrivacyFn and lookupIpinfoPrivacy. Both web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts and web/src/app/api/v1/freebuff/session/_handlers.ts now pass { ipinfoToken: env.IPINFO_TOKEN } to the lookup. Five files changed in total, touching env schema, CI defaults, docs, chat completions, and the freebuff session handlers.
ai.evidence: docs/environment-variables.md gains a line stating IPINFO_TOKEN is required for free-mode country gating; packages/internal/src/env-schema.ts and packages/internal/src/env.ts add IPINFO_TOKEN to the server schema, serverProcessEnv, and CI defaults; web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts rewrites getFreeModeCountryAccess to call IPinfo via lookupIpinfoPrivacy using env.IPINFO_TOKEN and adds the IPINFO_PRIVACY_CACHE_TTL_MS/IPINFO_PRIVACY_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES cache constants; web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts and web/src/app/api/v1/freebuff/session/_handlers.ts now await getFreeModeCountryAccess(req, { ipinfoToken: env.IPINFO_TOKEN })
ai.migration: Operators must set a non-empty IPINFO_TOKEN value in the service environment before deploying this commit, otherwise server startup env parsing fails and free-mode requests return country_blocked.
ai.unknowns: The IPinfo token is now required in production with no documented fallback, but the diff does not show how an existing deployment without IPINFO_TOKEN migrates or whether the value is injected from Infisical.

changes.what: getFreeModeCountryAccess is now async and calls IPinfo to detect VPN/proxy/Tor/relay/hosting traffic, with a 5000-entry, 30-minute TTL in-memory cache.
IPINFO_TOKEN added as a required server env var and wired into serverProcessEnv.
IPINFO_TOKEN added to CI defaults so tests parse the schema.
Free mode country lookup now passes env.IPINFO_TOKEN to getFreeModeCountryAccess.
Session country gate now passes env.IPINFO_TOKEN to getFreeModeCountryAccess.
Documents that IPINFO_TOKEN is required for free-mode country gating.
